
# ENCE - Method Comparison

## Setup

Load the Met Eireann daily data (not available in this Github repo)

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("scripts/idw.R")
source("scripts/MICE_elastic_net_C_implementation/elastic_net_R_glue.R")
source("scripts/MICE_elastic_net_C_implementation_cov/elastic_net_R_glue.R")
source("scripts/ENCE_elastic_net_C_implementation/elastic_net_R_glue.R")
source("scripts/ENCE_elastic_net_C_implementation_cov/elastic_net_R_glue.R")

# Load Met Eireann daily data and station geodata file
rain     <- read.csv("../../met_eireann_daily_data/daily_rainfall_2016.csv")
stations <- read.csv("../../met_eireann_daily_data/station_geodata.csv")

# Attach coordinates to each daily observation
rain <- merge(rain, stations[, c("stno", "east", "north")], by = "stno")

# Reshape to the format the rest of the code expects: stno, east, north, t, y
rain <- rain[, c("stno", "east", "north", "t", "rain")]
names(rain)[5] <- "y"

# Sorts the table in place by stno, then t
rain <- rain[order(rain$stno, rain$t), ]

# Compute missingness per station
# Counts the number of observed days per station
obs_per_station <- aggregate(!is.na(rain$y), list(stno = rain$stno), sum)#
# Renames columns
names(obs_per_station) <- c("stno", "n_obs")
# Adds a completeness column = observed days / 366.
obs_per_station$completeness <- obs_per_station$n_obs / 366

# Apply the % cutoff
cutoff <- 0.50
keep   <- obs_per_station$stno[obs_per_station$completeness >= cutoff]
rain   <- rain[rain$stno %in% keep, ]

# Then mask a fraction of the currently-observed cells
set.seed(541)
observed_idx <- which(!is.na(rain$y))
masked_idx   <- sort(sample(observed_idx, length(observed_idx) * 0.25))

df_miss <- rain
df_miss$y[masked_idx] <- NA           # hide masked
```


## Imputation

```{r run-MICE_DURR_cov, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("scripts/MICE_C_cov.R")
cov_time_mice_durr <- system.time({
  cov_imp_mice_durr <- MICE_DURR_cov(df_miss, response = "y", m = 1,
                                 max_impute_cycles = 5, hyp_cycles = 2, 
                                 init_method = "mean",
                                 max_EM_cycles = 8, 
                                 nclusters = 1,
                                 nthreads = 6L,
                                 outfile = NULL,
                                 lambda_options = c(0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01),
                                 alpha_options  = c(0.1, 0.35, 0.65, 0.9),
                                 transformation = sqrt,
                                 reverse_transformation = {function(x) x^2})
})
```

```{r run-MICE_DURR, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("scripts/MICE_C.R")
time_mice_durr <- system.time({
  imp_mice_durr <- MICE_DURR(df_miss, response = "y", m = 1,
                                 max_impute_cycles = 5, hyp_cycles = 2, 
                                 init_method = "mean",
                                 max_EM_cycles = 8,
                                 nclusters = 1,
                                 nthreads = 6L,
                                 outfile = NULL,
                                 lambda_options = c(0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01),
                                 alpha_options  = c(0.1, 0.35, 0.65, 0.9),
                                 transformation = sqrt,
                                 reverse_transformation = {function(x) x^2})
})
```

```{r run-ENCE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("scripts/ENCE_C.R")
time_ence <- system.time({
  imp_ence <- ENCE(df_miss, response = "y", max_cycles = 30,
                     init_method = "idw",
                     x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                     C = 15000,
                     transformation = sqrt,
                     reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                     truth = rain$y, masked_idx = masked_idx,
                     nthreads = 6)
})
```

```{r run-ENCE-cov, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
source("scripts/ENCE_C_cov.R")
cov_time_ence <- system.time({
  cov_imp_ence <- ENCE_cov(df_miss, response = "y", max_cycles = 30,
                     init_method = "idw",
                     x_name = "east", y_name = "north", t_name = "t",
                     C = 15000,
                     transformation = sqrt,
                     reverse_transformation = function(x) x^2,
                     truth = rain$y, masked_idx = masked_idx,
                     nthreads = 6)
})
```

## Results
```{r metrics}
y_true     <- rain$y[masked_idx]
mice_durr_y <- imp_mice_durr$y[masked_idx]
cov_mice_durr_y <- cov_imp_mice_durr$y[masked_idx]
ence_y <- imp_ence$y[masked_idx]
cov_ence_y <- cov_imp_ence$y[masked_idx]
```

```{r ENCE_results, results='hold'}
cat("ENCE:\n")
cat("Time: ", round(time_ence["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("RMSE:",   sqrt(mean((ence_y - y_true)^2)), "\n")
cat("Bias %:", sum(ence_y - y_true) / sum(y_true) * 100, "\n")
cat("R2:",     1 - sum((ence_y - y_true)^2) / sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2), "\n")
cat("SRMSE:",  sqrt(mean((ence_y - y_true)^2)) / mean(y_true), "\n\n")
```

```{r ENCE_results_cov, results='hold'}
cat("ENCE covariance updates:\n")
cat("Time: ", round(cov_time_ence["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("RMSE:",   sqrt(mean((cov_ence_y - y_true)^2)), "\n")
cat("Bias %:", sum(cov_ence_y - y_true) / sum(y_true) * 100, "\n")
cat("R2:",     1 - sum((cov_ence_y - y_true)^2) / sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2), "\n")
cat("SRMSE:",  sqrt(mean((cov_ence_y - y_true)^2)) / mean(y_true), "\n\n")
```

```{r MICE_DURR_results, results='hold'}
cat("MICE-DURR:\n")
cat("Time: ", round(time_mice_durr["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("RMSE:",   sqrt(mean((mice_durr_y - y_true)^2)), "\n")
cat("Bias %:", sum(mice_durr_y - y_true) / sum(y_true) * 100, "\n")
cat("R2:",     1 - sum((mice_durr_y - y_true)^2) / sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2), "\n")
cat("SRMSE:",  sqrt(mean((mice_durr_y - y_true)^2)) / mean(y_true), "\n\n")
```

```{r MICE_DURR_cov_results, results='hold'}
cat("MICE-DURR-covariance:\n")
cat("Time: ", round(cov_time_mice_durr["elapsed"], 2), "seconds\n")
cat("RMSE:",   sqrt(mean((cov_mice_durr_y - y_true)^2)), "\n")
cat("Bias %:", sum(cov_mice_durr_y - y_true) / sum(y_true) * 100, "\n")
cat("R2:",     1 - sum((cov_mice_durr_y - y_true)^2) / sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2), "\n")
cat("SRMSE:",  sqrt(mean((cov_mice_durr_y - y_true)^2)) / mean(y_true), "\n\n")
```
